fields.assessment_notes: Lucky Seven now reads stronger than the older Commander-only-plus-thin-social assessment. Fresh Wizards/EventLink evidence supports Sunday/Monday free Casual Commander plus current Thursday Pauper and Friday FNM Draft lanes, so Lucky Seven is a real multi-format Magic venue rather than just a pair of Commander listings. The store remains a plausible but not yet top-tier personal candidate: public community/social texture is still thin, and solo-arrival, pod formation, proxy norms, and event turnout remain unresolved. Check current event routing before traveling, especially for non-Commander nights.

operations.reason: Reflect fresh Wizards evidence that Lucky Seven has broader current Magic coverage than the existing Places read.
